explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step; at D1 it builds up over a run of unrewarded trials (about 1-4 after the first loss, 4-7 after the second, 9-10 after the third, often at the trial where the agent switches to the other action), and it stays 0 during runs of rewarded trials. After a peak it fades over the next one or two D1 steps (about 6-9, then 2-3, then 0), even when those trials are rewarded, and drops back to 0 once rewards come back steadily.
